Product Description:
Tayammum is an Arabic word and is an Islamic act meaning to purify yourself without water. Performable when clean water is not available or user suffers from a condition where they cannot use water.

Conditions for Dry Ablution:
• Prayer time has started.
• Sufficient water is not available for ritual washing (ghusal) or wudu.

Method of Tayammum:
1. Keep fingers wide open, hit clean earth once with palms of both hands.
2. Blow both hands and wipe your face.
3. Wipe your right hand with left hand, then left hand with right hand up to wrist.
